evidence.title: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI Complete Business Combination
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore. Nov. 4, 2026 — Agility Robotics , Inc. (“Agility”), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced the completion of its previously announced business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI (Nasdaq: CCXI) (“Churchill XI”), a special purpose acquisition company (the “Transaction”). Following the closing of the Transaction, Churchill XI’s common stock, warrants and units will cease trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market (“Nasdaq”) under their previous ticker symbols. The common stock and warrants of the combined company, Agility Robotics, Inc., are expected to begin trading on Nasdaq on November 5, 2026, under the ticker symbols “AGLT” and “AGLTW,” respectively. Churchill XI’s outstanding units have been separated into their underlying securities and will no longer be listed on Nasdaq following the closing of the Transaction. Agility develops humanoid robots and physical AI systems designed to augment the human workforce by automating repetitive and physically demanding tasks.
